title: TicWatch Pro 3 has a HUGE battery life. Collector support for it would be fantastic.
symptom: The TicWatch Pro 3 GPS does not receive Dexcom G6 readings when more than 10 feet away from the phone, and the user wants it to work as a standalone collector.
evidence_quote: It works right out of the box in conjunction with the phone but the second you're more than 10 feet away from it, the watch no longer receives readings.
